SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No...........
C. S. 6, Special Branch. Room 577
REPORT
Date June 13, 1938.
Subject Gambling at No. 14/16 Hwa Kee Avenue.
CONFIDENTIAL
Made by D. S. I. Medvedeff. Forwarded by Inspector E Pap

Information has been received from a neighbour
to the effect that public gambling is being secretly conducted
in a lodging house at No. 14/16 Hwa Kee Avenue, nightly after
1 a.m.

The following persons are living at present in
the above named lodging house :-

| Name of Person | Nationality | Occupation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1. Hong Kung Ching | Chinese | Lodging House licensee. |
| 2. Stonham, L.E. | British | Merchant. |
| 3. Mandelkoff, C. | Latvian | Clerk |
| 4. Issac, Mrs. Flora | Iraqian | - |
| 5. Pochinock, Mrs. I.M. | Russian | Nurse |
| 6. Vargos, Jose B. | Filipino | Musician |
| 7. Leung Chee Min | Chinese | Chinese Customs. |
| 8. Bantug, T.O. & Mrs. | Filipino | Merchant. |
| 9. Adams, R. Wajne | American | Musician. |
| 10. Sanda, Miss Alice | Chinese ? | Dancing Partner. |
| 11. Pan, S.H. & Mrs. | do | Merchant. |
| 12. Lee Yuen Chi, Miss | do | - |
| 13. Transilinh, J.R. | do | - |

| 15. Kimiko, Miss. | do | - |
| 16. Woo Ne Goo, Mrs. & daughter. | Chinese | - |

| 19. Tsai, C.S. | Chinese | - |
| 20. Dimaano, G. | Filipino. | Musician. |

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号...........
特别巡捕房 C. S. 6，577室
报告
日期：1938年6月13日。
事由：华格路（Hwa Kee Avenue）14/16号的赌博活动。
机密
由特别巡捕 D. S. I. Medvedeff 制作。经督察 E Pap 转呈

据一位邻居提供的情报称，在华格路（Hwa Kee Avenue）14/16号的一家寄宿公寓内，每晚凌晨1点后秘密进行公开赌博活动。

目前居住在上述寄宿公寓的人员如下：-

| 姓名 | 国籍 | 职业 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1. Hong Kung Ching | 华人 | 寄宿公寓执照持有人。 |
| 2. Stonham, L.E. | 英国人 | 商人。 |
| 3. Mandelkoff, C. | 拉脱维亚人 | 职员 |
| 4. Issac, Mrs. Flora | 伊拉克人 | - |
| 5. Pochinock, Mrs. I.M. | 俄国人 | 护士 |
| 6. Vargos, Jose B. | 菲律宾人 | 音乐家 |
| 7. Leung Chee Min | 华人 | 中国海关。 |
| 8. Bantug, T.O. & Mrs. | 菲律宾人 | 商人。 |
| 9. Adams, R. Wajne | 美国人 | 音乐家。 |
| 10. Sanda, Miss Alice | 华人？ | 舞伴。 |
